meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Agar aapki skin acne-prone (pimples wali) hai, toh ₹700 ke budget mein kuch acche aur effective options mil jayenge jo salicylic acid ya niacinamide par based hote hain. Ye ingredients acne aur acne marks ko kam karne mein madad karte hain:

### 1. Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum

* **Approx. Price:** ₹549 (30ml) / Smaller size is even cheaper (₹249)
* **Kyun kharidein:** Yeh active acne aur clogged pores (band pores) ke liye sabse best mana jata hai. Salicylic acid skin ke andar jaakar excess oil aur impurities ko saaf karta hai jisse pimples kam hote hain.

### 2. The Derma Co. 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum

* **Approx. Price:** ₹549 (30ml)
* **Kyun kharidein:** Isme salicylic acid ke sath-sath soothing ingredients bhi hote hain jo acne ki redness aur swelling ko kam karne mein help karte hain.

### 3. Dot & Key 10% Niacinamide CICA Anti-Acne Face Serum

* **Approx. Price:** ₹599 (30ml)
* **Kyun kharidein:** Agar aapko active acne ke sath-sath purane acne marks (daag) bhi hain, toh yeh CICA aur Niacinamide wala serum skin ko soothe karta hai aur marks ko light karta hai.

### 4. Plum 2% Salicylic Acid with 1% Hyaluronic Acid Liquid Peel / Serum

* **Approx. Price:** ₹550 ke kareeb
* **Kyun kharidein:** Yeh gentle exfoliation deta hai aur acne-prone oily skin ke liye kaafi accha option hai bina skin ko zyada dry kiye.

---

> **Tip:** Naya serum use karne se pehle apne haath ya kohni par **patch test** zaroor kar lein taaki yeh pata chal sake ki aapki skin ko suit kar raha hai ya nahi. Iske alawa, din ke samay sunscreen lagana bilkul na bhulein!
